description: Anti-fraud check of a payee BEFORE paying an invoice (against IBAN-change fraud / Business Email Compromise). Checks: IBAN (MOD-97 checksum + bank from the Italian ABI code), Italian VAT number (Partita IVA) and Codice Fiscale (checksum), and — when the EU service is reachable — the real company name via live VIES with a match against the expected name. Returns a verdict (ok / non_verificabile / attenzione / alto_rischio) + the specific red flags. `non_verificabile` (unverifiable) = no fraud signal BUT no authoritative source confirmed who the supplier is (Italian VAT number not registered in VIES, or no VAT number given): it is not an alarm, it is the refusal to say "ok" about an unidentified party. Unlike the other tools it performs external I/O (VIES): if VIES is down or the verification budget is temporarily exhausted, the verdict HONESTLY degrades to "attenzione" (warning), never a false "ok". Free (€0), no login. It does NOT replace out-of-band verification (calling the supplier on an already-known number).

ateco.description: Supplier's declared ATECO activity code (digits and dots only, optional).

codice_ateco.description: Alias di `ateco` (codice ATECO): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

expected_country.description: Supplier's expected country in ISO2 (default IT). A foreign IBAN is fraud red flag #1.

expected_name.description: Supplier's expected company name, compared with the official VIES one.

partita_iva.description: Alias di `vat_number` (Partita IVA): stesso dato, accettato perché altri tool di questo server lo chiamano così. Se mandi entrambi i nomi, i valori devono coincidere.

vat_number.description: VAT number with or without country prefix (e.g. IT12345678901).
